legacy: computeReview in index.html (07_engine.js) on the rows of parseBaseRows, run through tools/engine-host.js with the page's own upload path: totalCMV, totalInv, totalGL, invMissing, assetAllocation.rows, liqPie, allocByClient and allocByDistributor
new: app/src/engine/review.ts computeReview on app/src/ingest/load-base.ts: totals, assets, liquidity, byClient and byDistributor
notes: Every difference between the two outputs on the synthetic fixtures (the variants of the synthetic book and of tools/make-sample-base.js's book, both families, and the overview variants except hostile) must match exactly one entry, and every entry must be used, under TZ=Asia/Kolkata and TZ=UTC.

Both sides are projected into one shape before comparing (tests/parity/aggregation-compare.ts): Crore amounts, percentages as percent numbers, labels as strings, a missing value as null. Rows are matched by label and their order is compared on its own. The new matrices' not-given columns are paired with the legacy column labelled with the dash.

Diff kinds: total, asset-row, product-row, row-order, liquidity, matrix-col, matrix-cell, column-label. Keys name the row: the asset class; the class and product; the liquidity label; the level and column; the level, row and column of a cell.

An entry's key is an exact key, a list of keys, or a regular expression written between slashes. Classes follow 08-regression-test-plan.md section 5.4: correction (a known defect fixed, KI or OD named), improvement (a requirement changes the output), regression (a defect of the new code; must be empty for a merge).

Retired entries (as in the base-file ledger): when a legacy fix makes the live page give the new app's figures, the entry stays for the record with a retired reason naming the decision, and its former legacy pattern in legacyBefore. A retired entry matches nothing, so the difference coming back fails the test, and it need not be used. Fix batch 4 (D-041, CR-0009, index.html MD5 12B5E5727FCA01EF2EA162C59913F01D) retired AG-01, AG-02, AG-05, AG-06 and AG-08 (M1.4 fix round 2).

Total rows and merged purchase dates (D-041 points 2 and 3, KNOWN_ISSUES KI-148): the new reader skips a row named Total or Grand Total and dates a merged holding by its earliest folio, as the live page does, so the total-like, total-rows and merged-dates files give no difference here.

The hostile variant is not run through the legacy engine: an Asset Name such as constructor or __proto__ reaches the legacy aMap (a plain object) and makes computeReview throw or write to Object.prototype (the live page's defect; KI-151 is the new app's guard, pinned by tests/regression/ki-151-prototype-labels.test.ts).

entries.retired: Fix batch 4 (D-041 point 4, CR-0009, KI-143): the live page now reads a market value of "1.25 Cr" or "12abc" as blank and leaves the holding out, so neither side counts it and no difference is left.
entries.description: Two market values written as text that is not a number ("1.25 Cr", "12abc") are INVALID SOURCE DATA, so those holdings are excluded from every total and listed (BF-21). The legacy parseFloat read 1.25 and 12 Crore off the front of the text and counted both, which inflated the total market value, every percentage, the Equity and Mutual Funds rows, the client and distributor columns and their order.

entries.retired: Fix batch 4 (D-041 point 4, CR-0009, KI-143): the live page now reads an invested value of "1.25 Cr" as blank and leaves the two holdings without a market value out, so the invested value, gain and count without an invested value agree.
entries.description: The invested value written as "1.25 Cr" is INVALID SOURCE DATA and stays missing (BF-22), so that holding counts as one without an invested value and its class shows no invested value; and the two holdings excluded for an invalid market value (AG-01) take their invested values out of the totals. The legacy read 1.25 Crore off the text and summed the excluded holdings' invested values too. Gain follows as CMV minus invested over the holdings that have one.

The legacy read no holding from a file whose header is in row 6, or whose holdings follow a notes sheet, so it had no totals, rows, liquidity or matrices; the new reader finds the holdings (BF-11, BF-12) and the review shows them.

A holding with a blank Asset Name is Unknown, a class row of its own placed last, never Equity (BF-14). The legacy counted it in Equity, so its Equity row, product rows and matrix cells held it. The total-like files no longer show it: both readers skip their Grand Total row (D-041 point 3, KI-148).
